npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32236-01.html.text: Harkilgamed: You must be Kamael... What brings you to this blasted place? Did you really lay your hands on the Star of Destiny?

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32236-02.html.text: Harkilgamed: I am too busy to deal with you right now.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32236-07z.html.text: Harkilgamed: Good! Then capture their leaders and their chain of command will be temporarily broken. Defeat Shout of Splendor, Alliance of Splendor, Signet of Splendor, Crown of Splendor, Fang of Splendor, and Wailing of Splendor and bring me 62 of the Shining Medallions they possess. Understand?

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32236-08z.html.text: Harkilgamed: Did you obtain all items that you needed? I am occupied at the moment, but please visit me a little later and I will answer your questions then.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32236-03.html.text: Harkilgamed: Hmmph. What kind of bad joke is this? Metusela, who was in such close proximity to the Spicula, appearing now? Could it be what that man told be was true? Ah, excuse me -- I was just talking to myself. I am shocked, quite frankly. I had no idea that someone like you would appear... Wha…

links.text: Tell the story of meeting Katenar.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32236-04.html.text: Harkilgamed: I see. I suppose that in your friend's situation, he didn't think to watch what he was saying. I don't have that luxury, unfortunately... But I do have a great deal to tell you. You already know that our Three Heroes and our Elders are different beings from yourselves, right?

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32236-05.html.text: Harkilgamed: As I have just said, there are a couple of conditions we must continually contend with. That gang in front of me, for example, are actually beings called Angels. They will kill me if they can...

links.text: Is that because they are created beings?

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32236-06.html.text: Harkilgamed: Yes. We do not have a creator god. Surprised? I will tell you more, but this is too public a place, with too many listening ears nearby.
